exposure: ultrasound findings suggestive of morbidly adherent placenta (MAP)
placental tissue beyond the uterine cavity
cohort: 57 pregnant women with suspected MAP at Liaquat National Hospital, Karachi, Pakistan.
finding: There was a strong positive correlation (Spearman correlation coefficient = 0.78, p < 0.001) between ultrasound findings and intraoperative confirmation of morbidly adherent placenta (MAP).
